title: GET /management/v1/capabilities — success response
$comment: RC2 §12. Sortedness by capability_id and absence of duplicate capability_id values are enforced by invariants I-01 and I-02. additionalProperties is false for PROVIDER conformance only; see README.

capabilities.$comment: RC2 §12: sorted by capability_id, no duplicates, and MUST NOT include provider, model, prompt, database, schema, customer, or secret metadata — enforced structurally by additionalProperties: false on each entry.

contract_version.$comment: RC2 §12.2: the CAPABILITY contract's own MAJOR.MINOR version. Deliberately not constrained to the management contract's 1.0.

business_contract_id.$comment: RC2 §12.2: optional. Present only after the Business Contract is formally approved; v1.0 does not require it for guest.answer, and advertisement MUST NOT invent or reserve an unapproved identifier. Absent, never null (§8).
